title: Quadratic pair function tester
statement: For each natural number $n$, there is a randomized nonadaptive tester with four query positions, domain the disjoint union of a set of size $n$ and the proof-address set of size $2^n+2^{n^2}$, and Boolean codomain. It is obtained by reindexing the quadratic character pair tester and converting its field-with-two-elements answers to Boolean answers.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not describe the quadratic character pair tester or the reindexing and conversion constructions, so their mathematical behavior cannot be stated more specifically.
